rules.background: every change kept by these rules, at any residue, counted per entry and residue class
rules.depmap: a missense or stop call on the canonical isoform (UniprotID unlabelled or -1, else VepSwissprot) whose residue the 2026_03 canonical sequence has at the position; one row per (entry, position, new residue, line)
rules.tcga: FILTER PASS; in TCGA-OV and TCGA-LAML also FILTER wga alone (Ellrott et al. 2018); a missense or stop change on a transcript UniProt assigns to a reviewed entry's displayed isoform (all_effects); where the variant falls in no such transcript, a Missense_Mutation or Nonsense_Mutation of the MAF transcript (HGVSp_Short), placed on the entry SWISSPROT names, else on the entries of the gene symbol; kept where the 2026_03 canonical sequence has the changed residue at the position; one row per (entry, position, new residue, tumor sample)
